The identified controlling passage is Chapter 5 §5.5 Class declaration, opening grammar and explanation. The 1986 SIMULA Standard describes a class object as a dynamic instance of the class body, created by evaluating an object generator expression. The statement reports the standard's model for class instances, without claims about particular storage or implementation behavior. The paragraph separately compares object generation to evaluating a function designator. This analogy does not collapse the two constructs.
